title: OVER message-id always returns empty 224 — lookup not implemented
description: handle_over_live() at lifecycle.rs:771: when arg is OverArg::MessageId(_), it returns over_response(std::iter::empty()) without looking up the article. RFC 3977 §8.3 requires the server to find the article by message-id and return its overview data (or 430 if not found). Two additional bugs: (1) the function returns 412 no-group-selected for msgid args at line 741, but RFC 3977 explicitly allows OVER with msgid regardless of group selection state; (2) the stub silently succeeds (224) so callers see no error, just wrong data. Newsreaders using OVER msgid (e.g., for cross-referencing) will get empty results with no indication of failure.
